_comment: LA-11. Upstream addon zips from Trimitor/WDM-addons, pinned by content and not merely by tag. Update-Upstream.ps1 used to verify a download against the size the GitHub API reported for that same asset -- which is a recording, not a check: whatever can replace the asset behind a pinned tag can report its new size too, and the result is unreviewed third-party Lua staged into the payload and shipped to every client. These sha256s are the bytes that have actually shipped, hashed from Addons/upstream on 2026-08-23.
_howto: When you deliberately move to a new upstream tag: bump 'tag' here, run Update-Upstream.ps1, and it will HARD FAIL naming the new hash. Review the new addon code, then paste the hash in. The failure is the review prompt -- do not add a switch that skips it.
